verdicts.decision_note: The fabrication method is materially unresolved between a solid component and a ring with welded lugs.
The client establishes the manufacturing sequence represented by the CAD model and drawings: premachine POS 1–3, weld them, then perform final machining.
The source identifies an unresolved fabrication decision about machining allowances and post-weld finishing for surfaces 1 and 2.
The client sets the manufacturing instruction that surfaces 1 and 2 must be finished before welding and excluded from post-weld machining; no prior value keys become obsolete.
